About This Data Set
This report is based on interval meter data from the uploaded file. Channel codes identify the type of energy being measured: E1 = grid import active energy, B1 = export active energy, typically surplus solar sent to grid, Q1 = import reactive energy, K1 = export reactive energy. In this dashboard, E1 and B1 are used to assess load, export and solar opportunity, while Q1 and K1 are used for reactive power and power factor analysis.
